source: NASA FIRMS yearly country summary (standard processing)

properties_legend.version: FIRMS version (6.03 = MODIS C6.0, 61.03 = MODIS C6.1, 2 = VIIRS C2)
properties_legend.bright_k: brightness temperature, K (MODIS ch21/22, VIIRS I4)
properties_legend.fire_type: 0 vegetation, 1 volcano, 2 static land source, 3 offshore
properties_legend.counted: true if included in monthly metrics (fire_type filter)
